{{Quote|Did you see them? They must have been half a meter long, with teeth the size of gyv knives -|Lando Calrissian|<ref name="Insider126" />}}
'''Scrap rats''' were a species of scavenger creatures, which lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Vorrnti]]. They were half a [[Meter/Legends|meter]] long and had knife-like teeth. Like [[Garral/Legends|garrals]] from [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]],<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref> they were attracted by [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] engines, that is why repulsorlift vehicles were banned everywhere around [[Vorrnti City]], and facilities such as [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] or junkyards were surrounded with high solid walls or thorn hedges, as scrap rats could gnaw landing gear or other equipment.<ref name="Insider126" />
